mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, we are looking at clear skies and 44 degrees by Verona City Hall, with a lovely third quarter moon visible overhead.

October is officially Community Planning Month in Verona. Mayor Diaz issued a proclamation honoring our Planning and Development department for their data-driven work and expertise in managing the city's growth.
There is plenty to do, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Looking ahead, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company tomorrow.

On Sunday, September 14, a 37-year-old Verona man was taken into custody following a traffic stop where he was cited for operating after revocation and failing to install a court-ordered ignition interlock device.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist. Please note that the store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
